en: Black-and-white view of a European town square with a tall clocktower in the center background. In the left foreground stands a two‑storey building with a tiled roof and shopfront awnings; signage on the façade reads "Möbel-Magazin" and additional German text. Behind the tower, partially hidden by trees, is a large castle-like complex with round corner towers and steep roofs. The street in front is mostly empty, with an old streetlamp and a small monument or obelisk visible near the base of the hill leading up to the castle.
